stats.notes: CDS C1 totals for fall 2025 first-time, first-year students (men 1,681 + women 3,123 applied; 1,586 + 2,916 admitted; 255 + 404 enrolled). The residency split of applicants/admits (including international) was left blank in the CDS, so intl_applicants/intl_admits are empty; 11 of the 659 enrolled first-years were nonresidents (B2). GPA distribution is for all enrolled students (C11). Undergrad enrollment is B1 'Total all undergraduates' (2,365); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident count in that total (48). Early decision: none; early action: yes (C21/C22). No waitlist data reported. Test-optional.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8: SAT/ACT scores are used in admission decisions if submitted but not required (and used for advising).

cost.notes: CDS G1 for 2026-27 (first-year and all undergraduates): tuition 50,660; required fees 1,600; food and housing 11,770 (housing 5,890 + meals 5,880); books 500; residential transportation 1,080 not included in other. CDS H6: institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 40 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average 45,317 (total 1,812,685); H7 asks them only for an International Student's Certification of Finances.
